results.question: How many documents are in the knowledge graph?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document) RETURN count(d) AS document_count LIMIT 50

results.question: How many people are in the knowledge graph?
results.cypher: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN count(p) AS person_count LIMIT 50

results.question: How many locatedIn relationships are there in the graph?
results.cypher: MATCH ()-[:locatedIn]->() RETURN count(*) AS locatedInCount LIMIT 50

results.question: How many distinct organizations are mentioned in cluster 4?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document {cluster_id: 4})-[:mentions]->(:Organization) RETURN count(DISTINCT d) AS organization_count LIMIT 50

results.question: How many distinct people are mentioned in documents of cluster 19?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document {cluster_id: 19})-[:mentions]->(p:Person) RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS distinct_person_count LIMIT 50

results.question: How many documents from cluster 7 are in the graph?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document {cluster_id: 7}) RETURN count(d) AS document_count LIMIT 50

results.question: Which locations are mentioned in cluster 15?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document {cluster_id: 15})-[:mentions]->(l:Location) RETURN DISTINCT l.name AS location LIMIT 50

results.question: Which events are mentioned in cluster 12?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document {cluster_id: 12})-[:mentions]->(e:Event) RETURN DISTINCT e.name AS event_name LIMIT 50

results.question: What topics are the documents in cluster 6 about?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document {cluster_id: 6})-[:about]->(t:Topic) RETURN t.name AS topic LIMIT 50

results.question: Which organizations appear in both cluster 0 and cluster 18?
results.cypher: MATCH (d1:Document {cluster_id: 0})-[:mentions]->(o:Organization) WHERE EXISTS((d1)-[:mentions]->(o)) WITH o, count(d1) AS countInCluster0 MATCH (d2:Document {cluster_id: 18})-[:mentions]->(o) WHERE EXISTS((d2)-[:mentions]->(o)) WITH o, countInCluster0, count(d2) AS countInCluster18 WHERE countInCluster0 > 0 AND countInCluster18 > 0 RETURN o.name AS organization LIMIT 50

results.question: Which people are mentioned in more than one cluster?
results.gold_cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(p:Person) WITH p, count(DISTINCT d.cluster_id) AS clusters WHERE clusters > 1 RETURN p.name
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(p:Person) WITH p, COUNT(DISTINCT d.cluster_id) AS cluster_count WHERE cluster_count > 1 RETURN p.name AS person_name LIMIT 50

results.question: Which locations are mentioned in both cluster 15 and cluster 17?
results.cypher: MATCH (d1:Document {cluster_id: 15})-[:mentions]->(l:Location) WHERE EXISTS((d1)-[:mentions]->(l)) WITH l, COUNT(d1) AS count1 MATCH (d2:Document {cluster_id: 17})-[:mentions]->(l) WHERE EXISTS((d2)-[:mentions]->(l)) RETURN DISTINCT l.name AS location LIMIT 50

results.question: Which organizations are located in israel?

results.question: Which events take place in a location, and where?
